event.title: Democrats Target Ohio Seat Amid Renewed Abuse Allegations Against Rep. Max Miller
event.canonical_title: Democrats Target Ohio Seat Amid Renewed Abuse Allegations Against Rep. Max Miller
event.summary: Allegations against Ohio Representative Max Miller regarding abuse have gained renewed attention, coinciding with a legal dispute involving his former spouse, who is related to a prominent political figure. This situation has opened a potential opportunity for Democrats to contest the congressional seat in the upcoming elections.

key_facts: Allegations against Rep. Max Miller have been public for years.

Democrats see a chance to flip the congressional seat.
